name: CKEditor5 colgroup
description: Provides colgroup and col elements to CKEditor5 for when the table resize plugin is not enabled
project_description: This project provides a CKEditor 5 plugin that defines a model schema and upcast/downcast converters for the colgroup and col table elements. It exists so that these elements survive editing (rather than being stripped) when the core table.TableColumnResize plugin is not enabled. The plugin is purely client-side: it registers tableColumnGroup and tableColumn model elements and maps them to colgroup and col view elements, plus their span attribute. It provides no admin UI, routes, permissions, services or PHP code. Whether colgroup/col actually persist in saved content is governed entirely by the text format's filter_html allowed_html and the editor's Source Editing allowed_tags.
